headline: Senate confirms federal judge on eve of Domenico-St. John showdown, House rallies behind disabled veterans' benefits!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate confirmed Gregory Carl Cook as United States District Judge for the Northern District of Alabama by a 49-27 vote. Cloture votes were also agreed to on the nominations of Daniel Desmond Domenico for the Tenth Circuit (51-27) and Anna St. John for the Fifth Circuit (49-26), with confirmation votes scheduled for Monday. The chamber passed five bills including the Route 66 National Historic Trail Designation Act, the Fort Ontario Holocaust Refugee Shelter National Historical Park Establishment Act, and measures regarding public lands and forest health.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed H.R. 2102, the Major Richard Star Act, extending concurrent receipt of veterans' disability compensation and retired pay for combat-related disability retirees by an overwhelming 392-18 vote. The rule for consideration passed 271-135. The chamber introduced 24 new bills and 5 resolutions during the session.

onTheFloor.title: Major Richard Star Act - provides concurrent receipt of veterans' disability compensation and retired pay for combat-related disabilities
